channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Repasse de Vorcaro a Flávio Bolsonaro banca 2 “O Agente Secreto”
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, allegedly transferred US$10.6 million (R$61 million) to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro — an amount sufficient to fund two productions of Kleber Mendonça Filho's 'O Agente Secreto'. The payment was negotiated directly by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, with intermediaries including Eduardo Bolsonaro and Mario Frias, and sent to the Havengate fund in Texas. Flávio denied wrongdoing, stating the support was a private sponsorship with no quid pro quo.

item.title: O que esperar do day after da revelação da relação entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro
item.description: The revelation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's financial relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro, involving a 61 million reais transfer to fund the film 'Dark Horse', has triggered a crisis in his PL presidential pre-candidacy. Flávio confirmed the request but denied wrongdoing, announcing interviews to counter the fallout, while Lula's allies seek to prolong the damage. New developments are expected in the coming days, including a potential CPI into Banco Master.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro evita citar o 'irmão' Vorcaro em suas postagens sobre o Master
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoids mentioning his 'brother' Vorcaro in his posts about the Banco Master scandal, a strategy adopted since November 2025 to distance himself from the case. The discreet tactic aims to mitigate political damage by avoiding direct association with the individual involved in the scandal.

item.title: Como era o Brasil no ano do último título da seleção brasileira
item.description: In 2002, Brazil won its fifth World Cup title by defeating Germany 2-0, with both goals scored by Ronaldo. The country had 169 million inhabitants, 7.66% inflation, and 3.1% GDP growth that year. The victory was followed by the presidential transition from Fernando Henrique Cardoso to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, amid events such as the deaths of Chico Xavier and Claudinho, the Richthofen case, and the launch of the Nokia 6610.

item.title: Jogos de hoje, quinta, 14 de maio: onde assistir futebol ao vivo e horários
item.description: On Thursday, May 14, 2026, there is a busy sports schedule featuring Copa do Brasil (second leg of the fifth round), La Liga, Saudi Pro League, and Campeonato Paulista Feminino matches. Key fixtures include Corinthians vs Barra-SC, CRB vs Fortaleza, and Vitória vs Flamengo in the Copa do Brasil, along with Mirassol vs Ferroviária, Red Bull Bragantino vs Corinthians, Santos vs Palmeiras, and São Paulo vs Taubaté in the women's Paulista Championship.

item.title: Alcolumbre e Múcio se encontram um dia após constrangimento em posse do TSE
item.description: One day after a tense atmosphere between President Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre during the TSE inauguration, Defense Minister José Múcio met for hours with the senator at the Senate's Official Residence. The meeting suggests efforts to ease political tensions following the incident at the electoral tribunal.

item.title: Preocupados, pré-candidatos do PL avaliam se desvincular de Flávio após diálogos com Vorcaro
item.description: PL pre-candidates are concerned and evaluating whether to distance themselves from Flávio Bolsonaro after the revelation of his dialogues with Daniel Vorcaro by Intercept Brasil, which surprised allies and caused internal discomfort. The exclusive subscriber-only article suggests these conversations could affect the party's electoral strategy in 2026.

item.title: Bolsonaro manda ficar firme e nega Michelle como opção, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed he spoke with his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, after an audio leak in which he requested funding for the film 'Dark Horse'. Jair Bolsonaro urged him to 'stand firm' and ruled out any possibility of Michelle Bolsonaro running for president in 2026. Flávio denied any wrongdoing in the film's financing, arguing that private funding is legitimate, unlike the use of public funds by the PT.

item.title: 'Crise de proporções ainda incalculáveis': como a imprensa internacional noticiou conversa de Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro
item.description: International media highlighted the conversation between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, in which the former admitted requesting funds to finance a film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. According to The Intercept Brasil, the negotiated amount reached US$24 million, with R$61 million already disbursed between February and May 2025. Vorcaro is imprisoned over billion-dollar frauds at Banco Master and is negotiating a plea deal, while the scandal threatens Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign as the main opposition candidate in the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Valor que Vorcaro deu a filme de Bolsonaro era 13 vezes o caixa do Master ao ser liquidado
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro paid R$62 million to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro’s political trajectory, an amount 13 times greater than the cash reserves of Banco Master when it was liquidated by the Central Bank in November 2023. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president from the PL party, allegedly sent audio messages to Vorcaro demanding funds for the film’s production, as reported exclusively by Intercept Brasil.

item.title: Milhões de Vorcaro para filme são quase a metade do que Bolsonaro arrecadou para campanha presidencial de 2022
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, through Banco Master, allocated R$62 million for the production of a biopic about Jair Bolsonaro, following a request from the ex-president's son, Flávio Bolsonaro. This amount represents nearly half of what Bolsonaro raised for his 2022 presidential campaign, according to official TSE data. The exclusive subscriber-only article highlights the significant financial impact of this private contribution to a film tied to the former president.

item.title: Reviravolta na eleição
item.description: The revelation of Daniel Vorcaro's financing to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for a film about Jair Bolsonaro is portrayed as a political bomb capable of imploding his pre-campaign, highlighting abusive dialogues, suspicious intimacy, and single-view messages. The senator’s weak response worsens the situation, framing the film as a disguised electoral campaign piece.

item.title: Flávio negociou com Vorcaro meses após Bolsonaro atacar Master: ‘sistema agindo’
item.description: Five months after Jair Bolsonaro publicly criticized a suspected operation between Banco Master and Caixa Econômica Federal, his son Flávio Bolsonaro began negotiations for Daniel Vorcaro to contribute R$134 million to a film about the former president’s political trajectory. The contradiction between the father’s public stance and the son’s actions raises questions about political consistency and potential conflicts of interest. The subscriber-only article suggests the timing may be linked to an effort to rehabilitate the ex-president’s image following his attacks on the financial sector.

item.title: Deputado pede investigação sobre vazamento de áudios de Flávio
item.description: Federal Deputy José Medeiros (PL-MT) requested an investigation by the Ministry of Justice into the leaked audio of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) revealing negotiations for financing the film 'Dark Horse' with Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master. The audios show Flávio demanding overdue payments on a US$ 24 million deal from 2025, of which only US$ 10.6 million has been paid. Medeiros suspects selective leaking and political-media use of confidential material, suggesting possible leaks by authorities aligned with the federal government.

item.title: Master: Diálogos entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro são prenúncio de carnificina eleitoral
item.description: The revelation that Daniel Vorcaro negotiated R$62 million in payments with Flávio Bolsonaro for a film about Jair Bolsonaro using a shell company has shaken the right wing, while the Federal Police investigates former minister Ciro Nogueira over alleged kickbacks tied to the 'Master amendment'. The case raises suspicions of a corruption scheme involving public funds and Bolsonaro-aligned beneficiaries.

item.title: Líder do governo fala sobre impacto do episódio de Flávio em pesquisa
item.description: Government leader in the Senate, Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), stated that he has already seen the effects of the Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro episode in internal voting intention tracking polls, saying the impact will be inevitable in upcoming surveys. He spoke after the Intercept Brasil revealed that Flávio negotiated a US$24 million payment from Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro, with audio showing concern over delayed payments. Flávio defended himself by saying he was only seeking private sponsorship for a private film about his father, without granting favors or mediating government deals.

item.title: Lucro do Banco do Brasil cai 54% no 1º trimestre
item.description: Banco do Brasil posted adjusted net profit of R$ 3.4 billion in Q1 2026, down 53.5% year-on-year, primarily driven by an 85.8% increase in credit costs. Despite the profit decline, gross financial margin rose 14.8% annually, supported by financial income, retail credit growth, and treasury results, with expanded credit portfolio reaching R$ 1.3 trillion.

item.title: Flávio vai insistir em CPI do Master como estratégia para tentar se dissociar de escândalo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro reinforced his push for a parliamentary inquiry (CPI) into Banco Master as a strategy to politically distance himself from a scandal involving financier Daniel Vorcaro, after an audio surfaced in which he requested financial support for the film 'Dark Horse'. The audio caused internal campaign discomfort, contradicting his prior claim of having only a superficial relationship with Vorcaro. In a public statement, Flávio denied any wrongdoing, said he met Vorcaro only in December 2024, and shifted blame toward the Lula government.

item.title: Em uma semana, caso Master atinge Flávio e Ciro, e abre flanco de desgaste para a oposição
item.description: In less than a week, the Master Bank scandal hit two key opposition figures: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who sent an audio requesting money from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund a biopic about Jair Bolsonaro, and Senator Ciro Nogueira, targeted by a Federal Police operation. Although the PL reaffirms Flávio as its presidential pre-candidate, allies like Ricardo Salles advocate monitoring polls to assess a possible replacement, while others publicly reject the idea. The case deepens opposition wear and complicates alliances, such as with the União-PP federation.

item.title: Ministros do STF entendem que relevância penal de áudio entre Flávio e Vorcaro ainda será avaliada
item.description: STF ministers state that the penal relevance of the audio in which Flávio Bolsonaro requests financial aid from Daniel Vorcaro for the 'Dark Horse' film is still under analysis by the PF and PGR within Operation Compliance Zero. The Court emphasizes that the audio's presence in seized devices does not automatically trigger a new investigation, and it must be assessed whether it has legal ties to already-established facts. No formal requests have been submitted to the STF regarding the audio so far.

item.title: Conversas entre Vorcaro e Flávio Bolsonaro revelam intimidade com banqueiro e abalam candidatura
item.description: Audio recordings and text messages between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, reveal that the lawmaker requested payment of 'installments' to finance a biopic about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, while Vorcaro faced operational difficulties. The leaks, released yesterday, have shaken Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign by exposing a close financial relationship with a controversial figure, raising concerns about improper influence and misuse of resources.

item.title: Na sensação térmica da economia, Lula 3 perde para Lula 2
item.description: A comparison between Lula's second and third governments reveals a perception of worsening living conditions, despite improvements over the Bolsonaro administration. Retired carpenter Antônio, 65, exemplifies this sentiment: while acknowledging progress compared to the previous government, he laments the significant drop in purchasing power, with picanha prices tripling. The article highlights the disconnect between macroeconomic indicators and citizens' daily experiences.

item.title: Nunes Marques, Mendonça e Toffoli: saiba ministros do TSE nas eleições
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will have a renewed plenary for the 2026 elections, with Nunes Marques as president, André Mendonça as vice-president, and Dias Toffoli as an effective minister, replacing Cármen Lúcia. Flávio Dino will take the substitute minister seat vacated by Toffoli. The composition reflects the rotation between STF, STJ, and jurists, preserving the Court’s apolitical character.

item.title: Como a Faria Lima reagiu ao áudio de Flávio Bolsonaro para Vorcaro
item.description: The audio of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro requesting money from Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about his father caused a strong reaction in Faria Lima, with financial agents viewing the episode as a blow to his preferred presidential candidacy, increasing perceptions of fragility against Lula. The audio release led to a rise in the dollar and a drop in B3, prompting a search for alternatives, such as Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema, who labeled the request 'imperdoável'. Despite the initial impact, agents believe the effect may be temporary until the October elections.

item.title: Dupla cada vez mais entrosada, Evertton Araújo e Jorginho cadenciam meio-campo do Flamengo em decisão na Copa do Brasil
item.description: Evertton Araújo and Jorginho formed a solid midfield partnership for Flamengo, contributing to the team's ten-game unbeaten run across all competitions. The 23-year-old Araújo seized his starting opportunity after Erick Pulgar's shoulder injury and has improved, particularly in ball distribution, while Jorginho stabilized after early-year muscle injuries and returned to the form he showed in late 2025. Both are key to Flamengo's push for a Copa do Brasil quarterfinal spot against Vitória.

item.title: CPI do Banco Master é defendida por Flávio e governistas; criação depende de Alcolumbre
item.description: The CPMI on Banco Master was defended by Flávio Bolsonaro and government allies after audio emerged of him requesting R$134 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, is imprisoned for allegedly leading a billion-dollar financial fraud scheme reaching up to R$12 billion. The CPMI’s creation hinges on Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who refused to read the proposal with 280 signatures, reportedly due to an opposition deal to overturn vetoes on the dosimetry bill.

item.title: Empresa que repassou dinheiro para filme sobre Bolsonaro recebeu R$ 159 milhões de fundos investigados pela PF ligados a Vorcaro
item.description: Entre Investimentos received R$159.2 million from funds investigated by the PF linked to Banco Master fraud, which was used to intermediated payments for the Dark Horse film about Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio Bolsonaro was caught in messages and audio demanding payment from Daniel Vorcaro for the agreed R$124 million film deal, of which R$61 million has already been paid. Sefer Investimentos and the Gold Style fund, both tied to Vorcaro and under investigation for money laundering, were the main sources of the transfers.

item.title: Flávio mantinha contato com Vorcaro pelo WhatsApp; leia mensagens
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro maintained frequent contact with Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master imprisoned for financial fraud, via WhatsApp in 2025, discussing a $24 million investment in the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. Only $10 million was paid before Vorcaro's arrest in March 2026. Following the Intercept Brasil disclosure, Flávio confirmed the involvement but denied the use of public funds or illegality.

item.title: Peça-chave na campanha presidencial em Minas, Alexandre Silveira mira presidência da Petrobras
item.description: Minister of Mines and Energy Alexandre Silveira (PSD) is working behind the scenes to be appointed president of Petrobras in a potential next term of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. When questioned by email through the Ministry’s press office, he did not respond, keeping his ambitions confidential. The move is part of political maneuvering in Minas Gerais, a key state in the 2026 elections.

item.title: China fecha quarteirão para visita de Trump
item.description: China imposed extreme security measures for U.S. President Donald Trump's visit, sealing off the Four Seasons hotel block in Beijing and requiring U.S. embassy credentials for access, contrasting sharply with the open press access during Lula's visits in 2023 and 2025. Trump held bilateral meetings with Xi Jinping at the Great Hall of the People, including a dinner, underscoring the differential treatment of foreign leaders based on perceived global power.

item.title: A conversa entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Daniel Vorcaro - O Assunto #1719
item.description: Messages and audio reveal that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro requested over R$130 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro, accused by the PF of leading a billion-dollar fraud scheme, to finance the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro’s life, with R$61 million actually transferred. Although he initially denied the request, Flávio acknowledged the conversation, claiming it was about seeking private investors for a film about his father, and called for a CPi on Banco Master. The disclosure sparked national and international repercussion, raising doubts about the viability of his 2026 presidential pre-candidacy.

item.title: Estratégia de defesa de Flávio foi antecipada por Allan dos Santos
item.description: Allan dos Santos anticipated Flávio Bolsonaro's defense strategy in an Instagram video before the senator's public statement regarding his request for US$24 million from Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse'. The defense claims the funds came from a private entrepreneur, not public money or the Rouanet Law, and Flávio stated he received no improper advantages or mediated government deals. The case, revealed by Intercept Brasil, shows negotiations from February to May 2025, with a payment demand made one day before Vorcaro's arrest by the Federal Police.

item.title: Revogação eleitoreira da ‘taxa das blusinhas’ mostra governo desorientado
item.description: The Lula government revoked the 'blusinhas tax,' a 20% import duty on goods under US$50, less than five months ahead of the 2026 elections, aiming to make popular Asian e-commerce products cheaper. The move is part of a broader electoral benefits package that includes debt refinancing, expansion of Minha Casa, Minha Vida, fuel price controls, and credit lines for taxi and app drivers, widely seen as a strategy to boost popularity in an election year.

item.title: Não vai ter eleição no Rio
item.description: Two days after Eduardo Paes (PSD) advocated for direct elections in Rio de Janeiro following the conviction of former governor Cláudio Castro (PL), his main rival, Douglas Ruas (PL), publicly agreed with holding a popular vote before October to fill the vacancy left by Castro. However, 50 days later, neither side has commented on the interim governorship of Tribunal de Justiça president Ricardo Couto, upheld by a stay from Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin (STF), with Paes' allies silent for convenience and Ruas' faction silent out of fear.

item.title: Sangria de Flávio é dúvida até eleição
item.description: The scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro is already affecting markets, with the Ibovespa falling, the dollar rising, and betting odds declining for his presidential prospects. Dubbed the 'second Flávio Day,' it echoes the negative market reaction to his December candidacy launch, which undermined Tarcísio de Freitas as the market’s preferred candidate. While the exact impact on voting intentions remains unclear, the political and economic damage has already begun.

item.title: Análise: acordo de terras raras entre Brasil e EUA ainda está longe de se concretizar
item.description: The rare earth minerals cooperation agreement between Brazil and the U.S., despite being discussed in an impromptu meeting between Donald Trump and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at the White House, remains preliminary and far from being finalized. While it generated optimism and promises of stronger ties, no formal agreements, defined investments, or timelines have been established. The article notes that full access requires a subscription.

item.title: Taxa das blusinhas: calculadora do g1 mostra quanto ficaria sua compra com e sem o imposto
item.description: President Lula's administration repealed the 'blusinhas tax', a 20% federal import duty on low-value international purchases under US$ 50, making orders from platforms like Shopee, Shein, and AliExpress cheaper. Effective March 12, 2025 via a Provisional Measure, the change applies only to the Remessa Conforme program, while state-level ICMS remains in effect and purchases over US$ 50 still face a 60% import tax plus ICMS.

item.title: 'Topa jantar com o Jim Caviezel?': veja e ouça TODOS os textos e o áudio que mostram Flávio Bolsonaro pedindo dinheiro a Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro directly requested money from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to finance the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro, with payments totaling R$ 61 million between February and May 2025. Exchanged messages and an audio recording sent by Flávio show direct negotiations, though he denies wrongdoing and claims the request was legitimate. Vorcaro is imprisoned on accusations of leading a financial fraud scheme worth up to R$ 12 billion.

item.title: Vice-líder do PL na Câmara diz que Flávio errou ao não avisar bancada; parlamentares estão incomodados
item.description: The deputy leader of the PL in the Chamber, Alberto Fraga, stated that Flávio Bolsonaro erred by not informing the party caucus about his request for money from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro. Eight PL parliamentarians interviewed said they were extremely annoyed with the senator’s actions. Despite Flávio’s claims of no wrongdoing and that the request was a private sponsorship, Banco Master is implicated in a billion-dollar fraud scheme under investigation by the PF, and Vorcaro is imprisoned in Brasília.

item.title: Brasil tenta ocupar posição estratégica entre EUA e China
item.description: Brazil aims to occupy a strategic position between the U.S. and China by maintaining a non-aligned foreign policy to attract investment in critical minerals and technology. The Valor Brazil-USA Summit emphasized the need to fix fiscal policy, develop responsible AI, and strengthen cooperation in trade, regional security, and energy, ahead of the 2026 U.S. and Brazilian elections.

item.title: ‘Ninguém sabia o que fazer’: os bastidores da reunião de emergência na campanha de Flávio após caso Vorcaro
item.description: The revelation of negotiations between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro caused chaos in the PL campaign, prompting an emergency meeting in Brasília where allies sought to calm the team and postpone commitments. Flávio claimed the risk of further leaks was 'zero', while the campaign attempted to normalize the episode as an expected part of the pre-campaign. The case involves up to US$ 24 million (R$ 134 million), with part already disbursed, threatening efforts to distance Bolsonarism from financial scandals.

item.title: Aliados veem risco de desgaste para Flávio e começam a citar Michelle como alternativa após crise envolvendo Vorcaro
item.description: Allies of former President Jair Bolsonaro have begun mentioning Michelle Bolsonaro as a potential alternative to Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy following a scandal involving negotiations with banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse'. Despite growing concerns about electoral damage, no organized effort to replace Flávio's candidacy exists, and allies maintain it is too early to assess the scandal's electoral impact. The incident caused internal anxiety, particularly after an emergency campaign meeting in Brasília where Flávio claimed 'zero risk' of further leaks, though attendees remained uneasy about contradictions in his statements.

item.title: PT monta força-tarefa para criar conteúdo para as redes sobre envolvimento de Flávio com Vorcaro
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) has formed a task force to produce social media content about conversations in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro asked banker Daniel Vorcaro for money to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro. The strategy relies solely on the senator’s own words, without adjectives or exaggeration, to exploit the case as a political opportunity against Lula’s main rival in 2026. The PT views the truth about Flávio Bolsonaro as a 'rope that will hang his candidacy,' though it acknowledges the scandal is not yet enough to remove him from the electoral race.

item.title: ‘Efeito Flávio Bolsonaro’: Por que ligação entre presidenciável e dono do Banco Master mexeu com dólar e Bolsa?
item.description: Brazilian financial markets reacted negatively to news of presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro’s alleged ties to Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, who was arrested in the Banco Master scandal, triggering volatility. The dollar rose 2.31% to R$5, the Ibovespa fell 1.80%, and futures interest rates advanced, reflecting concerns over institutional risks and heightened political risk perception. The reaction occurred alongside the release of U.S. producer inflation data, which hit a four-year high, amplifying risk aversion.

item.title: O que Flávio Bolsonaro disse sobre o caso Master antes de mensagens revelarem pedidos de dinheiro a Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied involvement in the Banco Master scandal, but messages and audio revealed by Intercept Brasil show he solicited money from Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horses' about his father. After the revelation, he admitted the request, calling it 'private sponsorship for a private film,' and attempted to link the scandal to the PT, wearing a shirt that read 'O PIX é do Bolsonaro; o Master é do Lula'.

item.title: Lula “corrigiu rumo” ao rever taxa das blusinhas, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad stated that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva 'corrected course' by revoking the 'blusinhas' tax, a measure he initially supported but which Lula had always opposed. According to Haddad, Lula was pressured by governors and congressmen to defend the tax during its congressional passage, despite his personal opposition. He also accused allies of Jair Bolsonaro of hypocrisy for voting in favor of the tax and later advocating its repeal.

item.title: “Com R$ 134 milhões, até eu faço filme sobre Bolsonaro”, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) mocked the request for R$134 million made by Flávio Bolsonaro to finance the film "Dark Horse" about Jair Bolsonaro, saying that with that amount he himself could make a documentary about the former president. He criticized the normalization of practices linked to bolsonarism, calling it a "serious pathology" that society should not accept. Haddad spoke at the Democracy Forum in São Paulo, where he discussed democracy and Brazil's political landscape.

item.title: Haddad diz que Bolsonaro e Master “são uma coisa só”
item.description: Former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT) stated that the Bolsonaro family and the Banco Master scandal 'are one and the same,' linking banker Daniel Vorcaro to campaign donations for Jair Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas, and allies such as Ciro Nogueira and Fabio Wajngarten. He called for a deepening of the investigation by the Federal Police to clarify what he described as the largest banking fraud in the country's history.

item.title: Queiroga lança autobiografia no Senado
item.description: Former Health Minister Marcelo Queiroga launched his autobiography at the Senate, detailing his journey from the Paraíba backlands to leading the Health Ministry during the Covid-19 pandemic. The book promotes a methodological approach to health management, criticizes political and media narratives of the time, and reaffirms his loyalty to Jair Bolsonaro, while positioning himself as a pre-candidate for the Senate from Paraíba with a vision of 'bolsonarismo com raízes'.

item.title: Haddad afirma em SP que 'toda a relação do Daniel Vorcaro é com o governo Bolsonaro'
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) claimed that all of banker Daniel Vorcaro’s ties are linked to the Bolsonaro government, citing Central Bank authorization, campaign donations, and contacts with ministers. He mocked the leaked audio of Flávio Bolsonaro pressuring Vorcaro for R$134 million to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro, saying such requests are 'normal' among friends. Tarcísio de Freitas avoided commenting on the case during an interview about an explosion in São Paulo.
